title: Minicursos Temáticos
institution: Laboratório Nacional de Computação Científica (LNCC), Programa de Verão 2027
field: Scientific computing (HPC, data science, quantum computing, machine learning)
about: LNCC's 2027 summer programme offers thematic short courses on 22-26 February 2027, in hybrid format (in person in Petrópolis and on Zoom), on topics such as high-performance computing, data science, quantum computing and machine learning. Registration runs 2 November 2026 to 8 January 2027.
requirements: General fee R$ 30,00; free for LNCC members (institutional e-mail) and LNCC PIBIC/PIBIT scholarship holders (with proof)
Certificates only for participants following via Zoom; YouTube-only participation does not give a certificate
Each Programa de Verão event requires a separate registration

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: "Scientific computing (HPC, data science, quantum computing, machine learning)" → "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"
"Scientific computing (... machine learning)" → "Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)"
